subject: Adapter deadlock: request for sandbox bridge credits and trial extension
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@clearbridge.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-01 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Adapter deadlock blocking pilot — need runway padding

Hi Sergio / Marissa,

Quick note from the engineering team: our connector to Redwood's embedding endpoint is deadlocked on the auth handshake after the latest SDK drop. We hit the deadlock during batch sync yesterday and our QA queue is backed up — we can't complete the integration tests scheduled for next week.

Given this, our product team is worried about missing the demo window with execs on June 12. Can Redwood provide an interim sandbox credit (or trial extension) so we can keep integration work going while we sort the adapter fix? We can share logs — attached a trimmed log excerpt that shows repeated 401/handshake retries.

Appreciate any help; happy to jump on a quick call if that helps triage.

Thanks,
Anna Lopez
Head of Integrations, ClearBridge Logistics
anna.lopez@clearbridge.io
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: clearbridge_adapter_logs.txt (text)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@clearbridge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-01 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Adapter deadlock blocking pilot — need runway padding

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up and for the logs. I looked through the excerpt and I can see the repeated token refresh failures; that will definitely block your CI.

We want to keep ClearBridge on track for the demo. Marissa, can you confirm what runway (credits + extension) we can offer for a connectivity/integration blocker like this? The ask from Anna's team is effectively: keep the sandbox running and the evals flowing while they finish the adapter fix — they're asking for ~2 extra weeks and a modest credit top‑up to cover the stalled job re‑runs.

Anna — two quick asks from my side: 1) estimated new demo date if the team gets unblocked in two weeks; 2) whether your engineers can do a short pairing session with our SDK owner (I can organize that).

I'm copying Karthik to accelerate approval on the credit side.

- Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@clearbridge.io>
Date: 2025-06-02 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Adapter deadlock blocking pilot — need runway padding

Sergio / Karthik / Anna — quick notes after a sync with engineering and product:

- Situation: It's clearly an adapter/SDK handshake issue; engineering estimates a 3–5 business day fix if the teams can pair, otherwise could slip to ~2 weeks depending on priority.
- Customer impact: demo on Jun 12 is at risk if we don't buy a short runway.
- Proposed remedy: offer 10k sandbox credits (to cover replays and re‑runs) + a 14‑day trial extension on the pilot window. No changes to pricing — this is a one‑time operational makegood to preserve momentum.

Karthik — can you approve (10k credits, +14 days)? If yes I'll generate the approval stub and add to the HubSpot deal. Anna — if that works for you, please confirm the updated demo target date (best case) so we can set the extension end date correctly.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@clearbridge.io>
Date: 2025-06-04 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Adapter deadlock blocking pilot — need runway padding

Marissa / Sergio — approved.

Decision: Authorize a one‑time grant of 10,000 sandbox credits and extend the pilot window by 14 calendar days from the original trial expiration. Please log the approval under deal DB-3097 and attach the stub to the HubSpot record.

Operational notes:
- I'll have legal sign off needed language for the credit makegood (standard wording) and upload the approval PDF to the deal.
- Marissa — we should attach the credit stub and the DocuSign link below for Anna to sign acknowledging the extension and that it's a one‑time accommodation.

Anna — we can also schedule a 30‑minute pairing session tomorrow 10:30am PT with our SDK engineer (Kunal). Are you able to join? If so we'll send an invite.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
